title: Abyssals v0.90.34 — Permanent Growth
notes: Every original permanent growth-point bonus uses 1 + completed evolutions: Prodigy, stewardship, department-store growth tonics, nursery/memorial gifts and the rescue gift’s original birth-form advantage. Partner summaries display per-stat source maths. Tonic and batch-stewardship previews, donor eligibility and actual gains use the same multiplier. Original investments and dose/lesson counts stay unchanged; existing bonuses update future growth without rerolling earned stats. Temporary draughts stay flat and outside the full permanent rescue cap. Breeding excludes nonheritable stewardship/store training and evolution multiplier inflation. Preserves existing saves, eggs, lives, permanent deaths, quests and original APK signing. Existing shop prices and breeding fee unchanged.
